clue.text: Not using professionals to gather American university material

indicators.note: to gather is to enclose, so the do-it-yourself letters wrap round the university

parts.note: DIY, do-it-yourself, means doing a job without hiring professionals
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: Someone skips the experts and collects cloth from a US campus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to gather' is the container signal: the do-it-yourself abbreviation wraps round the American institute. 'material' is the definition, not part of the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Dimity is a light cotton fabric woven with raised stripes, a kind of material.

clue.text: Fine performers to get agents

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencils
actors are stage performers

explanation.surface: Good performers manage to sign up with agents.
explanation.definitionFit: Factors are agents in commerce, people who buy and sell on behalf of others.

clue.text: Object when doctor strangles bird

indicators.note: strangling wraps round the neck, so the doctor's letters surround the bird

parts.note: the emu is a large flightless Australian bird

explanation.surface: A protest at a doctor throttling a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: To demur is to raise an objection, so it is a verb synonym of object.

clue.text: Colour shown by maiden, perhaps, with fever

parts.note: in cricket a maiden is an over in which no runs are scored, so it is one kind of over
a fever of excitement is a state, as in 'getting into a state'

explanation.surface: A blushing young woman's colour with a high temperature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Colour' as a verb means to exaggerate or slant an account. A maiden over is a set of six balls in cricket with no runs conceded.
explanation.definitionFit: To colour a story is to exaggerate it, which is a verb synonym for overstating it.

clue.text: A large part of the world subject to chance — not good

definitions.text: A large part of the world

indicators.note: not here means the following letter is left out of the word

parts.note: contingent means dependent on chance events

explanation.surface: Most of the globe is a matter of luck, and not good luck.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing G from CONTINGENT leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A continent such as Asia or Africa is one of the great land masses of the world.

clue.text: Electrically connected back to front inside? Odd!

indicators.note: the last of the inner letters goes to the front of that inner run

parts.note: wired means connected up to an electrical supply

explanation.surface: A gadget hooked up with its insides reversed: how strange!
explanation.walkthrough: In WIRED the inside letters are IRE; moving their back letter E to their front gives EIR, so W-EIR-D.
explanation.definitionFit: Weird is a straightforward synonym of odd, meaning strange or peculiar.

clue.text: Run and run, bumping into little kid

indicators.note: bumping into suggests one thing pushed inside another, so R goes into the toddler

parts.note: a tot is a small child
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Someone jogs along and collides with a toddler.
explanation.definitionFit: To trot is to run at a gentle jogging pace.

clue.text: Thus pal becomes left without male role model?

definitions.text: Thus pal becomes left without male role model?

parts.words: Thus pal becomes left without male role model?
parts.note: remove PA, a dad, from the word pal and only L, the abbreviation for left, remains: the word pal deprived of its father

explanation.surface: A friend is abandoned by a boy's paternal figure.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a child left by a dad; cryptically the word 'pal' loses its 'pa' and becomes L for left.
explanation.definitionFit: Being without a dad, the paternal role model, is exactly what having no father means.

clue.text: Successive characters passionate and vicious

parts.note: D, E and F are consecutive letters of the alphabet
amatory means expressing sexual love or passion

explanation.surface: A run of letters both ardent and spiteful.
explanation.definitionFit: Defamatory remarks are malicious attacks on a reputation, so vicious in that sense.

clue.text: One lost in the country — compass needed

indicators.note: the numeral one goes missing from inside the nation's name

parts.note: Spain is the country here
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A traveller lost abroad needs a compass.
explanation.definitionFit: Span and compass both mean extent or range, as in the scope of a subject.

clue.text: Countryside hazard tot meets with hesitation

parts.note: to tot up is to add
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A small child out in the fields hesitates before something dangerous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tot' reads as a child but is the verb, to sum.
explanation.definitionFit: The adder is Britain's only venomous snake, a danger on country walks.

clue.text: Series of steps for remedy — one having the final word accepted?

parts.note: pro means in favour of, for

indicators.note: being accepted means being taken in, so the editor goes inside the remedy

parts.note: a cure is a remedy
an editor, ED, has the final say on what is printed

explanation.surface: A treatment plan, approved by whoever has the last word.
explanation.definitionFit: A procedure is an established sequence of actions for doing something.

clue.text: Scribe translating verse in vacated cellar

indicators.note: translating turns words into a new form, so these letters are reworked
a vacated cellar has its insides emptied, leaving only its outer letters

explanation.surface: A clerk renders poetry down in an empty basement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vacated' leaves CR from cellar; 'translating' shuffles VERSEIN with CR into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrivener was a professional writer or copyist, which is what scribe means.

clue.text: Bishop given barely believable responsibility

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
a lame excuse is a feeble, scarcely credible one

explanation.surface: A churchman handed a feeble excuse and the responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: Blame is the responsibility for a fault, as in taking the rap.

clue.text: Gift borne by this person, the ultimate in party wine

indicators.note: something borne is carried, so the gift sits inside the speaker

parts.note: me is the speaker, this person
alms are charitable gifts

indicators.note: the ultimate is the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A present carried by me, the final touch for a party: wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Malmsey is a sweet fortified Madeira wine.

clue.text: At this place heartless remark is a no-no for the faithful

parts.note: here means at this place

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter is taken out

parts.note: to say is to remark

explanation.surface: A cruel comment made here is forbidden to believers.
explanation.definitionFit: Heresy is belief contrary to orthodox doctrine, forbidden to devout followers.

clue.text: Dutiful volunteers and police group turned up to engage in activity

indicators.note: the reversed pieces engage, or lock into, the activity word

parts.note: a deed is an act or activity

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's reserve volunteer force
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: Conscientious volunteers and detectives arrived to take part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' makes DICAT from TACID, which 'to engage in' puts inside DEED.
explanation.definitionFit: Dedicated means devoted and committed to a task, close to dutiful.

clue.text: Outside part of hospital note object recalling past event?

indicators.note: outside puts the note around the hospital department

parts.note: a memo is a note
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department

explanation.surface: Outside a hospital ward a note reminds you of something that happened.
explanation.definitionFit: A memento is a keepsake kept as a reminder of a past event or person.

clue.text: Girl very dry goes topsy-turvy to become muddy

indicators.note: in a down entry turning upside down reads it backwards

parts.note: Di is a short girl's name, for Diana
brut describes the driest champagne

explanation.surface: A girl drinking dry wine falls over and gets muddy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes topsy-turvy' turns DIBRUT into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Turbid describes water clouded with sediment, which is what muddy means.

clue.text: Fast water under London

definitions.meaning: the River ... runs underground beneath London to the Thames

explanation.walkthrough: The Fleet is a lost London river, now culverted underground; Fleet Street is named after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Fleet means swift, and the Fleet is also a buried river under the capital.

clue.text: A tack used in Irish city that will contribute to sociological study

indicators.note: used in puts the stitch inside the city name

parts.note: Cork is a city in the south of Ireland
to tack is to stitch loosely, so sew

explanation.surface: A stitch done in Cork helps with research on society.
explanation.definitionFit: Casework is social work studying individual people or families in their circumstances.

clue.text: Somehow colourful work that comes with a way of life

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
a line, as in line of business, is a way of life or occupation

explanation.surface: A colourful piece of art goes with a lifestyle.
explanation.definitionFit: Opaline means like opal, iridescent and shimmering with shifting colours.

clue.text: Hastened to limit nitrogen in exhaust

indicators.note: limiting is bounding, so the hurried word encloses nitrogen

parts.note: sped means hurried, hastened
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A car raced to curb nitrogen in its tailpipe emissions.
explanation.definitionFit: To spend and to exhaust both mean to use up completely.

clue.text: Agreement to supply kitchen appliance couched in jargon

indicators.note: couched in means expressed within, so the appliance lies inside the jargon

parts.note: cant is specialist jargon
an oven is a kitchen appliance

explanation.surface: A deal to provide a cooker written in technical language.
explanation.definitionFit: A covenant is a formal agreement or binding contract.

clue.text: Worry about man with bad wife in immoral sexual activity

indicators.note: about means around, so the worry word surrounds the biblical man

parts.note: to harry is to harass or worry
in Genesis Lot's wife disobeyed by looking back and became a pillar of salt

explanation.surface: Fretting over a fellow whose spouse misbehaves amid sexual scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: Harlotry is prostitution or promiscuity, sexual immorality.

clue.text: Truly, wickedness descends on church and bank

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of what follows

parts.note: sin is wickedness
CE is the Church of England
to bank on is to rely

explanation.surface: Wickedness truly falls on the church and the bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' is the verb as in bank on, not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Sincerely and truly are both sign-offs for a letter and both mean genuinely.

clue.text: Devil wanders around and gains strength

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
to rove is to wander around

explanation.surface: A demon roams about and grows stronger.
explanation.definitionFit: To improve can mean to get better or recover, gaining strength.

clue.text: Lincoln initially feared possibly in the Union camp?

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters could be arranged another way
initially means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Abraham Lincoln at first feared he might be in the Union camp.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' is the anagram signal on 'feared', and 'initially' takes the first letter of Lincoln. In the American Civil War the Union forces were known as Federals, so the whole clue reads as a question about Lincoln.
explanation.definitionFit: The Federals were the troops of the northern Union in the American Civil War.

clue.text: Time after tree down?

indicators.note: after puts the time word behind the tree in the answer

parts.note: a plum is a fruit tree
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A clock ticks after the tree has fallen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'down' is not the direction or falling but soft feathers.
explanation.definitionFit: Down is the soft fluffy covering of young birds, an example of feathering.

clue.text: Pathetic payment wasted endlessly

parts.note: a fee is a payment

indicators.note: endlessly means the final letter is removed

parts.note: to blow money is to waste it, so blew

explanation.surface: A miserable fee squandered without end.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeble and pathetic both mean weak and inadequate.

clue.text: Like type of missile that is located in India

parts.note: as means like
a SAM is a surface-to-air missile

explanation.surface: A kind of rocket is stationed in India.
explanation.definitionFit: Assam is a state in north-eastern India, famous for tea.

clue.text: Bob's former make-up girl, along with others?

definitions.text: Bob's former make-up girl, along with others?

parts.words: Bob's former make-up girl, along with others?
parts.note: a bob was a shilling, made up of twelve of these old coins along with others

explanation.surface: A hairdresser's old cosmetics assistant joins the team.
explanation.walkthrough: A bob was a British shilling before decimalisation in 1971, worth twelve pence.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve old pennies made one shilling, nicknamed a bob, and Penny is a woman's name.
